output.summary: Approved G1034 design (replaces G1030; skill-only): the migrate skill reads each issue's milestone, gives each migrated goal or merge group a release, priority and dependencies in the triage (from milestones, labels, release-plan issues, dependencies, priority and the owner's direction, confirmed by the owner), checks release order and cycles over the whole set before any `new`, and passes release, priority and depends_on explicitly. MIGRATING's repository-specific line becomes general guidance. A CLI test pins that a refused `new` writes no goal ref. Review approved with no findings; implementer notes: one release rule for a merge group (earliest member's release, union of dependencies), fix a duplicated 'the' in Out of scope, keep the skill test to a few load-bearing phrases.

Migration gives every migrated goal an owner-confirmed release with no engine change. The migrate skill reads the milestone, its triage proposes a release (plus priority and dependencies) per MIGRATE goal and MERGE group from milestones, labels, the old release-plan body, dependencies and priority, checks release order and cycles over the whole set before any write, and step 5 passes release explicitly and creates dependencies first; `new`'s existing validation stays the backstop. MIGRATING's #695 line becomes general guidance (the fact moves to EXAMPLE.md), DESIGN §7's bullet is updated with a HISTORY §4 row, and tests add a skill-text check plus a CLI-level test pinning that `new` refuses a later-release dependency without writing a goal ref. A one-sentence handoff to G1025 (effective release, line targets) and a seam note for G1029 are included; a batch/dry-run `new` verb was rejected as disproportionate. (Resubmitted by the root under the new goal id after the original goal was deleted to remove private details; content unchanged apart from anonymisation and goal ids.)

Migrate skill steps 3-5 now read the milestone, propose and owner-confirm a release/priority/dependencies per MIGRATE goal and MERGE group (earliest member release, union of deps), check release order and cycles before any write, and pass fields explicitly creating dependencies first. MIGRATING.md, EXAMPLE.md, DESIGN section 7 and HISTORY section 4 updated. No engine change; legacy/store/docs/plugin tests pass (155).

The design meets the spec and its engine claims hold on dev 8d8437a: cli.py new takes release (default releases.current, l.353), schemas.validate_goal rule 4 refuses a dependency on a later release and a cycle before anything is pushed, request_key makes a rerun of an identical file safe (cli.py l.336-340), edit --set exists, MIGRATING.md line 43 and SKILL.md steps 3 to 5 read as described, the one existing --json assertion is at test_engine_legacy.py:570, and G1004-G1013 are release 2. Skill-only with a CLI-level backstop test is the right size; the batch verb, dry run and helper script rejections are reasoned and stay inside this goal, so no owner question. Non-blocking notes in the report: state the MERGE-group release rule, fix the 'the the private app' typo, and keep the skill test to a few load-bearing phrases.

The implementation matches the approved design and my notes. SKILL.md step 3 reads the milestone; step 4 adds the release, priority and dependency paragraph (ordered sources, one confirmed milestone mapping, 'no release' excluded, owner's sentence that a later release waits only to merge), the whole-set order and cycle check before any write, batch fields, and the proposal contents; step 5 creates goals in dependency order with explicit release, priority, depends_on and links, stops on a refusal and points to `edit --set release=`. The MERGE-group rule I asked for is there (earliest member's release, union of dependencies). MIGRATING.md is generalised, EXAMPLE.md gains the one dated owner-decision line (the older command lines stay as history), DESIGN.md section 7 and a HISTORY section 4 row are updated, and the stray 'the the' is not in shipped text. A git grep at 48e1be1 found no other place describing the triage that needs changing; docs/SKILLS.md line 9 still says 'inventory, triage, one go-ahead', which stays true. No private app name appears in plugins, docs or .agents. run_tests passed.

The tests match the approved design (Testing 1 and 2). I ran them at 8399a63: test_skill_assigns_a_release_per_goal fails on the current skill and MIGRATING text, and each of its assertions fails on its own against that text (milestone field, owner confirms release, 'may not depend on a goal of a later release', dependencies first, release/priority/depends_on in step 5, no #695 and 'later release' in MIGRATING); the phrases are load-bearing, not prose. The two NewReleaseOrderTests pass by design; as a mutation check I disabled the release-order branch of schemas.validate_goal rule 4 and the refusal test then errors, so it pins the behaviour, and it compares the remote goal refs before and after, so it also catches a refused new that wrote a ref. Non-blocking: the confirm regex's second alternative (confirm ... release within 200 chars) is loose; under the mutant the test fails with a KeyError on err['error'] rather than a clean assertion.

spec:
Found while designing G1003 (2026-11-01). The owner: "All goals are in scope - as part of the migration releases should be assigned". Today the migrate-zzzops-repository skill's triage (step 4) has no release field, step 5's `zzzops new` defaults every goal to settings.releases.current, and MIGRATING.md's "#695, all release 1" line is specific to this repository.

1. The triage table gains a release column; the skill proposes a release per goal (from the old issue's milestone or labels, its dependencies and priority) and the owner confirms or changes it.
2. `new` receives the release explicitly; dependencies are checked against release order (a goal may not depend on a later release) before any goal is created, and conflicts are shown in the triage.
3. MIGRATING.md's repository-specific line becomes general guidance.

Acceptance: the skill and MIGRATING document the release column and the confirmation; a skill test (or prompt_stats signal) checks it; if `new` or validation changes, engine tests cover it; this PR edits docs/design for contract changes and adds a HISTORY §4 row (G1017's rule).

Replaces G1030, whose branches were deleted to remove private details of the owner's dogfood app (owner decision, 2026-11-01).
title: Migration assigns each migrated goal a release
